prior_art.relevance: Establishes that phylogenetic signal occurs in ecological network structure and differs between antagonistic and mutualistic networks.
prior_art.novelty_boundary: Do not claim first phylogenetic signal in networks.

prior_art.coverage_note: ~11,000 bird species; raw individual morphological measurements and species-level morphology/ecology; hand-wing index and migration provide a prespecified mobility axis.
prior_art.use_boundary: Strong temporal trait/mobility source; fine-scale repeated spatial trait eligibility must be separately demonstrated.

prior_art.relevance: Large plant trait database with georeferenced records and ancillary metadata.
prior_art.use_boundary: Trait coverage is sparse and biased; georeferenced trait availability does not by itself establish a matched interaction sampling design.

prior_art.relevance: Current knowledge-graph integration of TRY plant traits and GloBI biotic interactions.
prior_art.use_boundary: Taxonomic integration helps source discovery; GloBI interaction records remain pairwise and heterogeneous in ecological sampling metadata.

prior_art.stable_release_context: METRIN-KG reports use of GloBI compressed stable release v0.8 from January 2025.
prior_art.relevance: Broad interaction discovery across many interaction types.
prior_art.use_boundary: Discovery/source crosswalk only until location, opportunity and sampling-effort semantics qualify a system.

prior_art.literature_reference: Poisot et al. 2015/2016 ecological network database and tools
prior_art.relevance: Network-level source architecture potentially suitable for repeated local networks.
prior_art.use_boundary: No programme is admitted until current network/site/date/effort metadata are audited source-by-source.
